PRINCIPLE: Tests must not depend on each other; use setup/teardown if needed. RATIONALE: Independence enables any-order or parallel execution. EVALUATION CRITERIA: Compliant if @Before/@BeforeEach or local variables only; non-compliant if shared mutable state without reset. DECISION RULES: (1) Check for @Before/@After. (2) Check for static/instance mutable state used by tests. (3) Check for numbered test names. (4) If only local variables used, compliant. PRINCIPLE: Tests should validate min/max/just-outside boundary inputs. RATIONALE: Boundaries are common fault locations. DECISION RULES: (1) Look for boundary data ("", 0, -1, MAX_VALUE). (2) Look for names containing 'boundary'/'edge'. (3) If all data is typical, non-compliant.
